answer: The cedar schedule is applied in wander and copper shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 57% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1632 impostors cost 706 times the honest price and take 20 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
